title: Three Years and One Short Stone
subtitle: 建筑工程 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 建筑工程（人与社会·建筑与工程）
meta: 主题语境：建筑工程（人与社会·建筑与工程）　|　核心词汇：foundation　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 foundation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the builder ① laid a foundation that no engineer in the street would have measured, and he said the laying was the whole of the year. The ② foundation, meaning the base itself and not the wall, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a foundation, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ foundation in that street had the same short stone beside it, and the ④ foundation at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the school and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A foundation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the builder said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the foundation was the whole of the matter, meaning the charity and not the base. The ⑥ foundation, meaning the charity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; foundation, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a base and a charity. He said the charity is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ foundation had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short stone. The ⑧ foundation of the whole thing, the builder wrote in May, was one street and three years of measuring; foundation, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ foundation I remember is the one measured in the plan, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the street. A ⑩ foundation, my mother said in 1973, is the only one that improves by being measured; every foundation, she said, is a charity that has agreed to look like a base. She said the charity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地基；基础（指街上每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 地基（指那一处本身，与墙体相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay a foundation 打一处地基
D. n. 地基（指留给学校的那一处）
E. n. 地基（抽象总称，指一条街上的打基之事）
F. n. 地基（指计划里写到、被量过的那一处）
G. n. 基金会；慈善机构（指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 基金会（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: laid a foundation that no engineer in the street would have measured
The foundation, meaning the base itself and not the wall
the foundation at the far end
the foundation was the whole of the matter
the foundation had become a line in a plan
The foundation of the whole thing

answers.why: lay a foundation 意为“打一处地基”，1962 年那位建筑工打了一处街上没有一位工程师肯量过的地基。
foundation 意为“地基”，指那一处本身而不是墙体，它经过了三年而在簿子上没有被量过。
foundation 意为“地基”，指街上每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一块矮矮的石头。
foundation 意为“地基”，指留给学校的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
foundation 意为“基金会、慈善机构”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这家基金会就是那件事的全部。
foundation 意为“基金会”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那处地基，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
foundation 意为“地基”，指计划里写到、被量过的那一处，到 1969 年这一处成了计划里的一行。
foundation 意为“地基”，建筑工五月写道，整件事的打基之事是一条街道和三年的量过。
foundation 意为“地基”，我记得的是计划里量过的那一处，1971 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一处。
foundation 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，一处地基是唯一会因为被好好量过而变得更好的东西。
